title: Connect your MDM without the connector
breadcrumb: Connect your MDM without the connector

slides.title: Start with a team
slides.html: The connector does all of this for you; by hand it takes technical staff. Make a team in Fleet for this Deploy App, and open enrolment in Deploy App to see the SCEP URL and the Challenge.

slides.title: Add Deploy App as an authority
slides.html: In Fleet: Settings, Integrations, Certificate enrollment. Add a custom SCEP authority with Deploy App's SCEP URL and Challenge.

slides.title: Add the certificate
slides.html: Choose your team at the top, then Controls, OS settings, Certificates, Add. Name rmscep, subject CN=$FLEET_VAR_HOST_END_USER_IDP_USERNAME_LOCAL_PART, OU=$FLEET_VAR_HOST_UUID.

slides.title: Add the policy
slides.html: Under Configuration profiles, add the policy file: the policy part of template.json in the connector's source, with your Deploy App's name as in its SCEP URL, such as unit.example.fi, for {domain} and rmscep for {key_alias}.

slides.title: Choose the apps
slides.html: Setup experience, Install software, Android: tick Chrome and the apps your unit uses. They install when a phone enrols, and at no other time.

slides.title: Let Chrome use the certificate
slides.html: Without a setting of its own, Chrome does not send the certificate. Under Software, with your team chosen, open Google Chrome, then Actions and Edit configuration.

slides.title: Chrome's setting
slides.html: Give Google Chrome the config part of Chrome in template.json, inside managedConfiguration, with your Deploy App's address, such as https://mtls.unit.example.fi, for {mtls_url}. Press Save.

slides.title: No Deploy App icon by hand
slides.html: Fleet's console cannot make the Deploy App icon: that takes the connector or Fleet's API. Without it, people open work Chrome and type your Deploy App's address.

slides.title: Then enrol and name
slides.html: Phones can now enrol. Name them in Fleet too: see Name phones without the connector.
